description.narrative:
A new CI Safe and Dignified Programming Working Group (SDPWG) has been set up as part of an initial two year project to replace and continue the work of the CI Accountability, Protection Mainstreaming and Real Time Evaluation Working Group (APR) and the interagency Safe & Dignified Programming Working Group (SDWG) of Caritas Australia, CRS and CAFOD.
The CI Safe and Dignified Programming Working Group (SDPWG) will build and sustain widespread commitment to Safe and Dignified Programming across the Caritas Confederation, ensuring that a mainstreamed, integrated, and systematic approach to this work is achieved in humanitarian and longer-term development, resilience, or peace programming. The Working Group will promote quality programming and adherence to safe and dignified programming standards by building collective commitment and awareness across the Confederation and supporting the development, dissemination and uptake of safe and dignified programming tools and resources. The Safe and Dignified Programming Framework is the primary document that guides the work of the Safe and Dignified Programming Working Group.
Recognising the interdependence of safeguarding and safe and dignified programming objectives, the SDPWG will work in collaboration with the Safeguarding Working Group, and both groups will work together towards joint objectives where relevant. Equally, recognising that safe and dignified programming is a pillar of quality humanitarian response, the SDPWG will support the work of the Caritas Humanitarian Accompaniment Team (CHAT), including through the provision of technical guidance and surge support to large scale humanitarian crises where required.
